title: Operations with Rational Expressions
standard_text: 2A.7F determine the sum, difference, product, and quotient of rational expressions with integral exponents of degree one and of degree two
meta_desc: Free Algebra II rational expression worksheets for Texas TEKS 2A.7F: simplify, multiply, divide, add and subtract rational expressions and complex fractions. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Factor first, then cancel common factors.
key_sub: To divide, multiply by the reciprocal.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Factor first. Cancel only common factors, never terms.
  • Multiply: multiply tops and bottoms, then cancel. Divide: multiply by the reciprocal of the second fraction.
  • Add or subtract: use a common denominator, then combine the numerators.
  • Values that make any denominator 0 are excluded from the domain.

Examples

Example

x2 − 9x2 + 5x + 6

(x − 3)(x + 3)(x + 2)(x + 3)

Answer: x − 3x + 2, x ≠ −2, −3

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Cancelling termsIn (x + 3) ÷ (x + 5) nothing cancels.
Adding denominatorsFind a common denominator instead.
Not flipping when dividingMultiply by the reciprocal.

faq.a: Determine the sum, difference, product, and quotient of rational expressions with integral exponents of degree one and of degree two.
The original expression is undefined there, even if the factor cancels.
A fraction with fractions in its numerator or denominator.

faq.q: How do you find a common denominator?
faq.a: Factor each denominator and use every factor the greatest number of times it appears.

items.q: Simplify x² − 10x + 24x² − 3x − 4.
items.e: Factor: (x − 4)(x − 6)(x − 4)(x + 1). Cancel the common factor (x − 4): x − 6x + 1, with x ≠ 4, −1. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 9x² − 7x + 12?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x − 3)(x − 4). It is 0 at both values, even though (x − 3) cancels with the numerator. x = 3 and x = 4.

items.q: Simplify x² + 5x − 6x² + 2x − 24.
items.e: Factor: (x + 6)(x − 1)(x + 6)(x − 4). Cancel the common factor (x + 6): x − 1x − 4, with x ≠ −6, 4. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − x − 42x² − 10x + 21?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x − 7)(x − 3). It is 0 at both values, even though (x − 7) cancels with the numerator. x = 3 and x = 7.

items.q: Simplify x² − 13x + 42x² − 8x + 12.
items.e: Factor: (x − 6)(x − 7)(x − 6)(x − 2). Cancel the common factor (x − 6): x − 7x − 2, with x ≠ 6, 2. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² + 3x − 28x² − 3x − 4.
items.e: Factor: (x − 4)(x + 7)(x − 4)(x + 1). Cancel the common factor (x − 4): x + 7x + 1, with x ≠ 4, −1. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 6x + 5x² + x − 30?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x − 5)(x + 6). It is 0 at both values, even though (x − 5) cancels with the numerator. x = −6 and x = 5.

items.q: Simplify x² − 9x + 20x² − 6x + 5.
items.e: Factor: (x − 5)(x − 4)(x − 5)(x − 1). Cancel the common factor (x − 5): x − 4x − 1, with x ≠ 5, 1. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² − 3x − 10x² − 4x − 12.
items.e: Factor: (x + 2)(x − 5)(x + 2)(x − 6). Cancel the common factor (x + 2): x − 5x − 6, with x ≠ −2, 6. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² + 7x + 10x² + x − 2.
items.e: Factor: (x + 2)(x + 5)(x + 2)(x − 1). Cancel the common factor (x + 2): x + 5x − 1, with x ≠ −2, 1. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² + 9x + 18x² + 4x − 12.
items.e: Factor: (x + 6)(x + 3)(x + 6)(x − 2). Cancel the common factor (x + 6): x + 3x − 2, with x ≠ −6, 2. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² − 11x + 30x² − 13x + 42.
items.e: Factor: (x − 6)(x − 5)(x − 6)(x − 7). Cancel the common factor (x − 6): x − 5x − 7, with x ≠ 6, 7. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² + 11x + 28x² + 5x − 14?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x + 7)(x − 2). It is 0 at both values, even though (x + 7) cancels with the numerator. x = −7 and x = 2.

items.q: Simplify x² + 9x + 20x² + 3x − 10.
items.e: Factor: (x + 5)(x + 4)(x + 5)(x − 2). Cancel the common factor (x + 5): x + 4x − 2, with x ≠ −5, 2. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² + 8x + 7x² + 13x + 42.
items.e: Factor: (x + 7)(x + 1)(x + 7)(x + 6). Cancel the common factor (x + 7): x + 1x + 6, with x ≠ −7, −6. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² + 6x + 5x² + 4x + 3?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x + 1)(x + 3). It is 0 at both values, even though (x + 1) cancels with the numerator. x = −3 and x = −1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 2x − 35x² + 6x + 5.
items.e: Factor: (x + 5)(x − 7)(x + 5)(x + 1). Cancel the common factor (x + 5): x − 7x + 1, with x ≠ −5, −1. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² + 9x + 20x² + 7x + 12.
items.e: Factor: (x + 4)(x + 5)(x + 4)(x + 3). Cancel the common factor (x + 4): x + 5x + 3, with x ≠ −4, −3. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² − 4x − 21x² − 8x + 7.
items.e: Factor: (x − 7)(x + 3)(x − 7)(x − 1). Cancel the common factor (x − 7): x + 3x − 1, with x ≠ 7, 1. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 4x² + 3x − 10?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x − 2)(x + 5). It is 0 at both values, even though (x − 2) cancels with the numerator. x = −5 and x = 2.

items.q: Simplify x² − 10x + 24x + 6 ÷ x² − 4x − 12x + 6.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 6)(x − 4)x + 6 · x + 6(x − 6)(x + 2). Factor and cancel (x − 6) and (x + 6): x − 4x + 2.

items.q: Simplify x² + 6x + 5x² + 10x + 24 · x + 4x + 5.
items.e: Factor: (x + 5)(x + 1)(x + 4)(x + 6) · x + 4x + 5. Cancel (x + 5) and (x + 4): x + 1x + 6.

items.q: Simplify x² − 11x + 28x² + 7x + 6 · x + 6x − 4.
items.e: Factor: (x − 4)(x − 7)(x + 6)(x + 1) · x + 6x − 4. Cancel (x − 4) and (x + 6): x − 7x + 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 16x² + 5x − 6 · x + 6x + 4.
items.e: Factor: (x + 4)(x − 4)(x + 6)(x − 1) · x + 6x + 4. Cancel (x + 4) and (x + 6): x − 4x − 1.

items.q: Simplify x² + 8x + 15x² + x − 42 · x − 6x + 3.
items.e: Factor: (x + 3)(x + 5)(x − 6)(x + 7) · x − 6x + 3. Cancel (x + 3) and (x − 6): x + 5x + 7.

items.q: Simplify x² − 6x + 5x² − 2x − 3 · x − 3x − 1.
items.e: Factor: (x − 1)(x − 5)(x − 3)(x + 1) · x − 3x − 1. Cancel (x − 1) and (x − 3): x − 5x + 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 4x − 21x² − 10x + 24 · x − 6x + 3.
items.e: Factor: (x + 3)(x − 7)(x − 6)(x − 4) · x − 6x + 3. Cancel (x + 3) and (x − 6): x − 7x − 4.

items.q: Simplify x² − 5x + 6x² + 10x + 24 · x + 4x − 2.
items.e: Factor: (x − 2)(x − 3)(x + 4)(x + 6) · x + 4x − 2. Cancel (x − 2) and (x + 4): x − 3x + 6.

items.q: Simplify x² + 3x + 2x² − 11x + 30 · x − 5x + 1.
items.e: Factor: (x + 1)(x + 2)(x − 5)(x − 6) · x − 5x + 1. Cancel (x + 1) and (x − 5): x + 2x − 6.

items.q: Simplify x² + 4x − 5x − 6 ÷ x² + 6x + 5x − 6.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 5)(x − 1)x − 6 · x − 6(x + 5)(x + 1). Factor and cancel (x + 5) and (x − 6): x − 1x + 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 9x + 18x² + x − 2 · x + 2x − 6.
items.e: Factor: (x − 6)(x − 3)(x + 2)(x − 1) · x + 2x − 6. Cancel (x − 6) and (x + 2): x − 3x − 1.

items.q: Simplify x² + 5x − 14x² − 7x + 6 · x − 1x − 2.
items.e: Factor: (x − 2)(x + 7)(x − 1)(x − 6) · x − 1x − 2. Cancel (x − 2) and (x − 1): x + 7x − 6.

items.q: Simplify x² + x − 42x² + x − 12 · x + 4x + 7.
items.e: Factor: (x + 7)(x − 6)(x + 4)(x − 3) · x + 4x + 7. Cancel (x + 7) and (x + 4): x − 6x − 3.

items.q: Simplify x² + 5x + 4x² − 11x + 30 · x − 6x + 4.
items.e: Factor: (x + 4)(x + 1)(x − 6)(x − 5) · x − 6x + 4. Cancel (x + 4) and (x − 6): x + 1x − 5.

items.q: Simplify x² + 6x + 5x − 3 ÷ x² − 6x − 7x − 3.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 1)(x + 5)x − 3 · x − 3(x + 1)(x − 7). Factor and cancel (x + 1) and (x − 3): x + 5x − 7.

items.q: Simplify x² − 9x + 18x + 1 ÷ x² − 8x + 15x + 1.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 3)(x − 6)x + 1 · x + 1(x − 3)(x − 5). Factor and cancel (x − 3) and (x + 1): x − 6x − 5.

items.q: Simplify x² − 6x + 5x − 6 ÷ x² + 6x − 7x − 6.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 1)(x − 5)x − 6 · x − 6(x − 1)(x + 7). Factor and cancel (x − 1) and (x − 6): x − 5x + 7.

items.q: Simplify x² − 4x − 5x² + 6x + 8 · x + 4x − 5.
items.e: Factor: (x − 5)(x + 1)(x + 4)(x + 2) · x + 4x − 5. Cancel (x − 5) and (x + 4): x + 1x + 2.

items.q: Simplify x² − 11x + 30x − 7 ÷ x² − x − 20x − 7.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 5)(x − 6)x − 7 · x − 7(x − 5)(x + 4). Factor and cancel (x − 5) and (x − 7): x − 6x + 4.

items.q: Simplify x² − 7x + 6x² + x − 20 · x + 5x − 1.
items.e: Factor: (x − 1)(x − 6)(x + 5)(x − 4) · x + 5x − 1. Cancel (x − 1) and (x + 5): x − 6x − 4.

items.q: Simplify 2x + 1 − 4x + 7.
items.e: LCD = (x + 1)(x + 7). Rewrite: 2(x + 7)(x + 1)(x + 7) − 4(x + 1)(x + 1)(x + 7). Combine the numerators: 2(x + 7) − 4(x + 1) = −2x + 10. −2x + 10(x + 1)(x + 7).

items.q: Simplify 1x + 6 + 4x + 4.
items.e: LCD = (x + 6)(x + 4). Rewrite: 1(x + 4)(x + 6)(x + 4) + 4(x + 6)(x + 6)(x + 4). Combine the numerators: 1(x + 4) + 4(x + 6) = 5x + 28. 5x + 28(x + 6)(x + 4).

items.q: Simplify 6x − 7 + 1x + 6.
items.e: LCD = (x − 7)(x + 6). Rewrite: 6(x + 6)(x − 7)(x + 6) + 1(x − 7)(x − 7)(x + 6). Combine the numerators: 6(x + 6) + 1(x − 7) = 7x + 29. 7x + 29(x − 7)(x + 6).

items.q: Simplify 8xx + 5 − xx + 5.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 7xx + 5. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 5x − 4 − 1x + 6.
items.e: LCD = (x − 4)(x + 6). Rewrite: 5(x + 6)(x − 4)(x + 6) − 1(x − 4)(x − 4)(x + 6). Combine the numerators: 5(x + 6) − 1(x − 4) = 4x + 34. 4x + 34(x − 4)(x + 6).

items.q: Simplify 6x + 1 + 3x + 4.
items.e: LCD = (x + 1)(x + 4). Rewrite: 6(x + 4)(x + 1)(x + 4) + 3(x + 1)(x + 1)(x + 4). Combine the numerators: 6(x + 4) + 3(x + 1) = 9x + 27. 9x + 27(x + 1)(x + 4).

items.q: Simplify 2x − 7 + 1x + 5.
items.e: LCD = (x − 7)(x + 5). Rewrite: 2(x + 5)(x − 7)(x + 5) + 1(x − 7)(x − 7)(x + 5). Combine the numerators: 2(x + 5) + 1(x − 7) = 3x + 3. 3x + 3(x − 7)(x + 5).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 7 − 6x + 4.
items.e: LCD = (x − 7)(x + 4). Rewrite: 4(x + 4)(x − 7)(x + 4) − 6(x − 7)(x − 7)(x + 4). Combine the numerators: 4(x + 4) − 6(x − 7) = −2x + 58. −2x + 58(x − 7)(x + 4).

items.q: Simplify 7xx + 1 + 3xx + 1.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 10xx + 1. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 3x − 1 + 2x + 6.
items.e: LCD = (x − 1)(x + 6). Rewrite: 3(x + 6)(x − 1)(x + 6) + 2(x − 1)(x − 1)(x + 6). Combine the numerators: 3(x + 6) + 2(x − 1) = 5x + 16. 5x + 16(x − 1)(x + 6).

items.q: Simplify 6x + 6 + 2x − 3.
items.e: LCD = (x + 6)(x − 3). Rewrite: 6(x − 3)(x + 6)(x − 3) + 2(x + 6)(x + 6)(x − 3). Combine the numerators: 6(x − 3) + 2(x + 6) = 8x − 6. 8x − 6(x + 6)(x − 3).

items.q: Simplify 8xx − 4 + 7xx − 4.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 15xx − 4. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 3x − 2 + 1x − 1.
items.e: LCD = (x − 2)(x − 1). Rewrite: 3(x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 1) + 1(x − 2)(x − 2)(x − 1). Combine the numerators: 3(x − 1) + 1(x − 2) = 4x − 5. 4x − 5(x − 2)(x − 1).

items.q: Simplify 5x + 6 + 2x + 2.
items.e: LCD = (x + 6)(x + 2). Rewrite: 5(x + 2)(x + 6)(x + 2) + 2(x + 6)(x + 6)(x + 2). Combine the numerators: 5(x + 2) + 2(x + 6) = 7x + 22. 7x + 22(x + 6)(x + 2).

items.q: Simplify 5xx − 1 − 4xx − 1.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: xx − 1. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 2x + 1 + 6x + 5.
items.e: LCD = (x + 1)(x + 5). Rewrite: 2(x + 5)(x + 1)(x + 5) + 6(x + 1)(x + 1)(x + 5). Combine the numerators: 2(x + 5) + 6(x + 1) = 8x + 16. 8x + 16(x + 1)(x + 5).

items.q: Simplify 3x − 5 + 6x − 2.
items.e: LCD = (x − 5)(x − 2). Rewrite: 3(x − 2)(x − 5)(x − 2) + 6(x − 5)(x − 5)(x − 2). Combine the numerators: 3(x − 2) + 6(x − 5) = 9x − 36. 9x − 36(x − 5)(x − 2).

items.q: Simplify 3x − 6 − 1x + 2.
items.e: LCD = (x − 6)(x + 2). Rewrite: 3(x + 2)(x − 6)(x + 2) − 1(x − 6)(x − 6)(x + 2). Combine the numerators: 3(x + 2) − 1(x − 6) = 2x + 12. 2x + 12(x − 6)(x + 2).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 5 − 3x + 1.
items.e: LCD = (x − 5)(x + 1). Rewrite: 4(x + 1)(x − 5)(x + 1) − 3(x − 5)(x − 5)(x + 1). Combine the numerators: 4(x + 1) − 3(x − 5) = x + 19. x + 19(x − 5)(x + 1).

items.q: Simplify 1x + 3 + 6x + 1.
items.e: LCD = (x + 3)(x + 1). Rewrite: 1(x + 1)(x + 3)(x + 1) + 6(x + 3)(x + 3)(x + 1). Combine the numerators: 1(x + 1) + 6(x + 3) = 7x + 19. 7x + 19(x + 3)(x + 1).

items.q: Simplify 1 + 4x1 − 16x².
items.e: Multiply the top and bottom by x²: x² + 4xx² − 16. The bottom is a difference of squares: x(x + 4) ÷ ((x + 4)(x − 4)) = xx − 4.

items.q: Simplify 1 + 3534 − 12.
items.e: Top: 1 + 35 = 85. Bottom: 34 − 12 = 14. Divide: 85 ÷ 14 = 325.

items.q: Simplify 1 + 2323 − 12.

items.q: One pump fills a tank in 5 hours and another in 20 hours. Working together, what fraction of the tank do they fill in one hour?
items.e: Add the rates: 15 + 120 = 14 of the tank per hour.

items.q: One pump fills a tank in 3 hours and another in 6 hours. Working together, what fraction of the tank do they fill in one hour?
items.e: Add the rates: 13 + 16 = 12 of the tank per hour.

items.q: A group shares a $120 bus rental equally. With x people each pays $120x. If 2 more people join, how much less does each person pay?
items.e: 120x − 120x + 2 = 120(x + 2) − 120xx(x + 2) = 240x(x + 2) dollars.

items.q: A group shares a $180 bus rental equally. With x people each pays $180x. If 2 more people join, how much less does each person pay?
items.e: 180x − 180x + 2 = 180(x + 2) − 180xx(x + 2) = 360x(x + 2) dollars.

items.q: A group shares a $300 bus rental equally. With x people each pays $300x. If 2 more people join, how much less does each person pay?
items.e: 300x − 300x + 2 = 300(x + 2) − 300xx(x + 2) = 600x(x + 2) dollars.

items.q: A rectangle has area x² + x − 12 and width x + 4. Which expression is its length?
items.e: Length = area ÷ width. Factor the area: (x + 4)(x − 3). Cancel (x + 4): x − 3.

items.q: Grace drives 180 miles to a city at x mph and returns at x + 15 mph. Which expression gives the total driving time in hours?
items.e: Time = distance ÷ rate: 180x + 180x + 15. Use the LCD x(x + 15): 180(2x + 15)x(x + 15).

items.q: One pump fills a tank in 2 hours and another in 6 hours. Working together, what fraction of the tank do they fill in one hour?
